title: Measuring exposure and vulnerability to Nigeria's 2012 floods: Views from the ground and views from the sky
abstract: Floods are one of the most damaging natural hazards globally, but measuring local impacts is complicated by challenges in the measurement of flood incidence, especially in Global South contexts. This paper examines household-level exposure and vulnerability to the major 2012 floods in Nigeria and studies how sensitive estimates are to different approaches to flood measurement. We construct seven different measures of flood incidence from survey reports, flood databases, and satellite imagery, which capture both physical inundation and reported damages. We find limited cross-measure correlations in flood incidence, while exposure estimates range from 0.03 to 13% of the total country population and 2–38% of survey households. While we do not claim to estimate causal impacts, the measures also disagree on whether household flood exposure is associated with decreases in agricultural output during the affected growing season, with only survey-based measures showing significant—and large—average losses ranging between 20 and 60% of pre-flood levels. When combining multiple measures, our results show that agricultural losses are greatest for households reporting direct flood-related harvest losses in communities where floods are detected by different sources, suggesting that considering multiple sources of flood exposure may help to identify the worst-affected communities. We conclude with three recommendations for future research: (1) examine multiple metrics of flood exposure and understand what they measure and their pros and cons, (2) align the empirical strategy and interpretation of results with the specific nature of what a given flood metric captures, and (3) conduct sensitivity analyses on outcomes of interest.
abstract_zh: 洪水是全球破坏性最强的自然灾害之一，但由于洪水发生率的测量存在困难，尤其是在全球南方地区，测算其对当地的影响十分复杂。本文考察了尼日利亚2012年大洪水中家庭层面的暴露程度与脆弱性，并研究了估计结果对不同洪水测量方法的敏感程度。我们利用调查报告、洪水数据库和卫星影像，构建了七种不同的洪水发生率指标，这些指标同时涵盖了实际淹没情况和报告的损失。我们发现，各指标之间的洪水发生率相关性有限，暴露估计值的范围从全国总人口的0.03%至13%，以及调查家庭的2%–38%。虽然我们并不声称估计了因果影响，但这些指标对于受灾生长季内家庭洪水暴露是否与农业产出下降相关，也存在分歧：只有基于调查的指标显示出显著且较大的平均损失，幅度在洪水前水平的20%至60%之间。在综合多种指标后，我们的结果表明，在不同来源均探测到洪水的社区中，报告直接因洪水造成收获损失的家庭农业损失最为严重，这表明考虑多种洪水暴露来源可能有助于识别受影响最严重的社区。最后，我们提出了未来研究的三点建议：（1）考察多种洪水暴露指标，理解它们所衡量的内容及其优缺点；（2）使实证策略和结果解释与特定洪水指标所捕捉的具体性质相一致；（3）对所关注的结果进行敏感性分析。

title: Land and poverty: the role of soil fertility and vegetation quality in poverty reduction
Exposure to floods, climate change, and poverty in Vietnam
venue: Economics of Disasters and Climate Change
abstract: With 70 percent of its population living in coastal areas and low-lying deltas, Vietnam is highly exposed to riverine and coastal flooding. This paper examines the exposure of the population and poor people in particular to current and future flooding in Vietnam and specifically in Ho Chi Minh City, using new high-resolution flood hazard maps and spatial socioeconomic data. The national-level analysis finds that a third of today’s population is already exposed to a flood, which occurs once every 25 years, assuming no protection. For the same return period flood under current socioeconomic conditions, climate change may increase the number exposed to 38 to 46 percent of the population. Climate change impacts can make frequent events as important as rare ones: the estimates suggest a 25-year flood under future conditions can expose more people than a 200-year flood under current conditions. Although poor districts are not found to be more exposed to floods at the national level, the city-level analysis of Ho Chi Minh City provides evidence that slum areas are highly exposed. The results of this paper show the benefits of investing today in flood risk management, and can provide guidance as to where future investments may be targeted.
abstract_zh: 越南有70%的人口生活在沿海地区和低洼三角洲，因此该国高度暴露于河流洪水和沿海洪水之中。本文利用新的高分辨率洪水危险性地图和空间社会经济数据，考察了越南尤其是胡志明市人口，特别是穷人，在当前及未来洪水面前的暴露情况。全国层面的分析发现，在不设防护的情况下，当今三分之一的人口已经暴露于每25年一遇的洪水之中。在当前社会经济条件下，对于同一重现期的洪水，气候变化可能使暴露人口增加至总人口的38%至46%。气候变化的影响可能使频繁事件与罕见事件同样重要：估计结果表明，未来条件下的25年一遇洪水，可能比当前条件下的200年一遇洪水暴露更多人口。尽管在全国层面，贫困地区并未被发现比其他地区更易遭受洪水，但对胡志明市的城市层面分析表明，贫民窟地区的暴露程度很高。本文的结果表明，今天投资于洪水风险管理具有益处，并可为未来投资的目标地点提供指导。

title: A global-level model of the potential impacts of climate change on child stunting via income and food price in 2030
abstract: BACKGROUND: In 2016, 23% of children (155 million) aged [Formula: see text] were stunted. Global-level modeling has consistently found climate change impacts on food production are likely to impair progress on reducing undernutrition. OBJECTIVES: We adopt a new perspective, assessing how climate change may affect child stunting via its impacts on two interacting socioeconomic drivers: incomes of the poorest 20% of populations (due to climate impacts on crop production, health, labor productivity, and disasters) and food prices. METHODS: We developed a statistical model to project moderate and severe stunting in children aged [Formula: see text] at the national level in 2030 under low and high climate change scenarios combined with poverty and prosperity scenarios in 44 countries. RESULTS: We estimated that in the absence of climate change, 110 million children aged [Formula: see text] would be stunted in 2030 under the poverty scenario in comparison with 83 million under the prosperity scenario. Estimates of climate change-attributable stunting ranged from 570,000 under the prosperity/low climate change scenario to [Formula: see text] under the poverty/high climate change scenario. The projected impact of climate change on stunting was greater in rural vs. urban areas under both socioeconomic scenarios. In countries with lower incomes and relatively high food prices, we projected that rising prices would tend to increase stunting, whereas in countries with higher incomes and relatively low food prices, rising prices would tend to decrease stunting. These findings suggest that food prices that provide decent incomes to farmers alongside high employment with living wages will reduce undernutrition and vulnerability to climate change. CONCLUSIONS: Shifting the focus from food production to interactions between incomes and food price provides new insights. Futures that protect health should consider not just availability, accessibility, and quality of food, but also the incomes generated by those producing the food. https://doi.org/10.1289/EHP2916.
abstract_zh: 背景：2016年，全球有23%的儿童（1.55亿人）年龄在[公式：见正文]岁之间发育迟缓。全球层面的模型一贯发现，气候变化对粮食生产的影响可能会阻碍减少营养不良的进展。目标：我们采取了一个新视角，评估气候变化如何通过影响两个相互作用的社会经济驱动因素，进而影响儿童发育迟缓：一是最贫穷20%人口的收入（由于气候对作物生产、健康、劳动生产率和灾害的影响），二是粮食价格。方法：我们建立了一个统计模型，用以预测44个国家在2030年、低和高两种气候变化情景与贫困和繁荣情景相结合下，[公式：见正文]岁儿童在国家层面的中度和重度发育迟缓情况。结果：我们估计，在没有气候变化的情况下，2030年在贫困情景下将有1.1亿名[公式：见正文]岁儿童发育迟缓，而在繁荣情景下为8300万人。气候变化导致的发育迟缓估计人数，从繁荣/低气候变化情景下的57万人，到贫困/高气候变化情景下的[公式：见正文]人不等。在两种社会经济情景下，气候变化对发育迟缓的预计影响在农村地区都大于城市地区。在收入较低且粮食价格相对较高的国家，我们预计价格上涨往往会加剧发育迟缓；而在收入较高且粮食价格相对较低的国家，价格上涨往往会减少发育迟缓。这些发现表明，既能为农民提供体面收入、又能提供高就业率和生活工资的粮食价格水平，将减少营养不良和气候变化脆弱性。结论：将关注点从粮食生产转向收入与粮食价格之间的相互作用，提供了新的见解。保护健康的未来不仅应考虑粮食的可获得性、可及性和质量，还应考虑生产粮食的人所获得的收入。https://doi.org/10.1289/EHP2916。

title: Disaster risk, climate change, and poverty: assessing the global exposure of poor people to floods and droughts
abstract: People living in poverty are particularly vulnerable to shocks, including those caused by natural disasters such as floods and droughts. Previous studies in local contexts have shown that poor people are also often overrepresented in hazard-prone areas. However, systematic evidence across countries demonstrating this finding is lacking. This paper analyzes at the country level whether poor people are disproportionally exposed to floods and droughts, and how this exposure may change in a future climate. To this end, household survey data with spatial identifiers from 52 countries are combined with present-day and future flood and drought hazard maps. The paper defines and calculates a “poverty exposure bias” and finds support that poor people are often overexposed to droughts and urban floods. For floods, no such signal is found for rural households, suggesting that different mechanisms—such as land scarcity—are more important drivers in urban areas. The poverty exposure bias does not change significantly under future climate scenarios, although the absolute number of people potentially exposed to floods or droughts can increase or decrease significantly, depending on the scenario and the region. The study finds some evidence of regional patterns: in particular, many countries in Africa exhibit a positive poverty exposure bias for floods and droughts. For these hot spots, implementing risk-sensitive land-use and development policies that protect poor people should be a priority.
abstract_zh: 贫困人口特别容易受到冲击的影响，包括洪水和干旱等自然灾害所造成的冲击。以往针对局部地区的研究表明，贫困人口在灾害易发地区中也往往占比过高。然而，目前缺乏能够跨国论证这一发现的系统性证据。本文从国家层面分析贫困人口是否不成比例地暴露于洪水和干旱之中，以及这种暴露在未来气候下可能如何变化。为此，我们将来自52个国家的带有空间标识的住户调查数据，与当前及未来的洪水和干旱灾害地图相结合。本文定义并计算了“贫困暴露偏差”，并发现贫困人口往往过度暴露于干旱和城市洪水之中。对于洪水，农村住户未发现此类信号，这表明在城市地区，土地稀缺等其他机制可能是更重要的驱动因素。在未来气候情景下，贫困暴露偏差并未发生显著变化，但可能暴露于洪水或干旱的绝对人口数量，则可能根据情景和地区的不同而显著增加或减少。研究发现了一些区域性规律的证据：特别是，非洲的许多国家在洪水和干旱方面均表现出正的贫困暴露偏差。对于这些热点地区，实施保护穷人的、对风险敏感的土地利用和发展政策应当成为优先事项。

title: Households and heat stress: Estimating the distributional consequences of climate change
abstract: Recent research documents the adverse causal impacts on health and productivity of extreme heat, which will worsen with climate change. In this paper, we assess the current distribution of heat exposure within countries, to explore possible distributional consequences of climate change through temperature. Combining survey data from 690,745 households across 52 countries with spatial data on climate, this paper suggests that the welfare impacts of added heat stress may be regressivewithincountries. We find: (1) a strong negative correlation between household wealth and warmer temperature in many hot countries; (2) a strong positive correlation between household wealth and warmer temperatures in many cold countries; and (3) that poorer individuals are more likely to work in occupations with greater exposure. While our analysis is descriptive rather than causal, our results suggest a larger vulnerability of poor people to heat extremes, and potentially significant distributional and poverty implications of climate change.
abstract_zh: 近期研究记录了极端高温对健康和生产率的不利因果影响，而这一影响将随气候变化而加剧。本文评估了当前各国内部的高温暴露分布，以探讨气候变化通过温度可能产生的分配后果。本文将来自52个国家690,745户家庭的调查数据与气候空间数据相结合，发现增加的热应激对福利的影响在国家内部可能具有累退性。我们发现：（1）在许多炎热国家，家庭财富与较高温度之间存在强烈的负相关；（2）在许多寒冷国家，家庭财富与较高温度之间存在强烈的正相关；（3）较贫穷的个人更可能从事暴露程度较高的职业。尽管我们的分析是描述性而非因果性的，但结果表明，穷人更易受极端高温影响，气候变化可能产生显著的分配和贫困影响。

title: The multifaceted relationship between environmental risks and poverty: new insights from Vietnam
abstract: Despite complex interlinkages, insights into the multifaceted relationship between environmental risks and poverty can be gained through an analysis of different risks across space, time and scale within a single context using consistent methods. Combining geo-spatial data on eight environmental risks and household survey data from 2010–2014 for the case study of Vietnam, this paper shows: (i) at the district level, the incidence of poverty is higher in high risk areas, (ii) at the household level, poorer households face higher environmental risks, (iii) for some risks the relationship with household-level consumption varies between rural and urban areas, and (iv) environmental risks explain consumption differences between households, but less so changes over time. While altogether these analyses cannot establish a causal relationship between environmental risks and poverty, they do indicate that Vietnam's poor are disproportionally exposed. Given growing pressures due to climate change, addressing such risks should be a focus of poverty reduction efforts.
abstract_zh: 尽管环境风险与贫困之间存在复杂的相互联系，但通过在单一背景下、采用一致的方法，分析不同风险在空间、时间和尺度上的差异，仍可以获得关于二者多维关系的见解。本文以越南为案例，结合八种环境风险的地理空间数据以及2010–2014年的住户调查数据，表明：（i）在区级层面，高风险地区的贫困发生率更高；（ii）在家庭层面，较贫困的家庭面临更高的环境风险；（iii）对于某些风险，其与家庭层面消费的关系在城乡之间存在差异；（iv）环境风险可以解释家庭之间的消费差异，但对消费随时间变化的解释力较弱。尽管这些分析整体上无法确立环境风险与贫困之间的因果关系，但它们确实表明越南的穷人不成比例地暴露于环境风险之中。鉴于气候变化带来的压力日益增大，应对此类风险应成为减贫努力的重点。

title: Regulating climate change in the courts
abstract: Chapter 9 relates climate legislation, which is passed by parliaments, to climate litigation, which is pursued through the courts. Using data from 25 countries, the chapter documents how the judiciary is playing an increasingly active role in climate policy, both complementing and in some cases substituting for national legislation. The majority of climate litigation cases fall into one of three categories. In the first category, climate change is at the periphery of the argument. A second category of cases deals with administrative matters related to specific projects. Only in the third category are climate change concerns at the core of the case, and these cases divide equally into lawsuits oriented towards climate policies and legislation, information and disclosure, and loss and damage. Looking at the outcomes of litigation cases, the chapter finds that the courts have so far tended to enhance, rather than curtail, climate change regulation, confirming the important role of courts in regulating climate change.
abstract_zh: 第9章探讨了由议会通过的气候立法与通过法院提起的气候诉讼之间的关系。本章利用来自25个国家的数据，记录了司法机关在气候政策中发挥的作用日益积极，既补充国家立法，在某些情况下也取而代之。大多数气候诉讼案件可归入三类之一。在第一类中，气候变化只处于辩论的边缘。第二类案件涉及与具体项目相关的行政事务。只有在第三类案件中，气候变化问题才处于案件的核心，这些案件在针对气候政策与立法、信息与披露，以及损失与损害的诉讼之间平均分布。从诉讼结果来看，本章发现，迄今为止法院更倾向于加强而非削弱气候变化监管，这证实了法院在规范气候变化方面的重要作用。
